messages:
Maddie: opened a PR to harmonize retention language and SDK examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4912
Ken: quick skim — Python uses `retention_days`, Node uses `ttl` and Ruby shows `retention_ttl_days`. We should standardize one key in examples to avoid confusion.
Maddie: intent was to unify on `retention_ttl_days` to be explicit about units. PR also has a small migration note.
Julian: users copy snippets; can we keep old key in examples but mark as deprecated? breaking change could be painful.
Ken: agree. examples should show the recommended key but include a short line: "legacy key `retention_days` accepted until vX.Y".
Susan (Legal): legal note: avoid absolute phrases like "we delete after X days". For SOC2-friendly wording use: "data is retained for up to X days unless subject to legal hold or export request." Also prefer the phrase "retention period" in copy.
Maddie: updated copy: "Default retention period is 30 days. Use `retention_ttl_days` in SDK calls to override. Legal holds will prevent deletion." Kept code to show both keys in a comment. PTAL @Susan (Legal)
Susan (Legal): that phrasing is fine. Add one sentence about exports: "Exports will include events inside the retention period unless otherwise requested by legal/support."
Julian: small code nit: Python snippet currently shows `client.export_audit_logs(retention_days=30)`. Change to `client.export_audit_logs(retention_ttl_days=30)` and add a comment: "# retention_days deprecated; accepted until vX.Y"
Maddie: done in branch. I also swapped the raw curl example for a CLI-first example: `rictl audit export --retention 30` since we tell customers to prefer SDK/CLI. Left raw HTTP in appendix.
Ken: good call. please ensure the human-facing docs say "retention period" even if code uses `ttl` naming. Also link to SDK changelog entry for the deprecation.
Maddie: added changelog link and a migration checklist in the PR description.
docs-bot: PR opened by Maddie: #4912 — "align retention phrasing + unify SDK examples" (labels: docs, soc2, sdk-snippet)
Susan (Legal): approved language pending inclusion of the exports sentence. :white_check_mark:
Julian: LGTM aside from a tiny Ruby formatting comment.
Ken: I'll notify SDK owners about the deprecation window. plan to ship changelog tomorrow after docs CI.
Maddie: merging once CI passes. will keep the compatibility shim for one release and follow up with an SDK patch if needed. Thanks all :tada:
